objective: Independently check the new warm/replay faces in the closed resource trial's original 32x16 sphere counterexample.
geometry: The unchanged 32x16 latitude/longitude samples at radius 10, represented in Q(zeta_32) at positive scale 4/radius. No reduced or floating input.
method: Reuse the immutable independent integer cyclotomic oracle and outward rational Taylor interval helpers. Check every new face for nondegeneracy, outward support against every original point, and a strictly outside anchor-plus-normal control. Zero-containing intervals require an exact zero determinant remainder. Reuse old proofs only for exactly equal oriented original-index faces, with all prior artifacts hash-checked.
additional_checks: Reparse warm/replay transcripts, check full vertex use, distinct faces, opposite edge incidence, connected face adjacency and Euler characteristic two. Compare exact coplanar original-index sets and triangle counts on changed supporting planes.
